LESSON: CULTURE AND SOCIAL ORGANISATION

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Culture and Social Organisation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Culture and Social Organisation
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How would we preserve positive aspects of African traditional culture?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe age-groups and age- sets in African traditional society
2. explain the functions of a clan in traditional African society
3. identify aspects of African traditional culture that ought to be preserved

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: describe age-groups and age- sets in African traditional society

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW
